NOTE: The Patch will not hit until next week. This is just a taste.
 
Agents!
 
Halloween is almost upon us! Prepare yourself for some strange goings on in our Dimension! 
 
 
▣ 3 New Characters
 
          3 New characters have joined Marvel Future Fight!          

With new characters, new team bonuses and achievement have been added as well.
 
▣ 6 New Uniforms
  - New uniforms for Ghost Rider, Blade, Black Cat, M.O.D.O.K., Punisher, and Lash

Table to come with bonuses, BUT:
-Ghost Rider- 70's Classic
-Blade- 70's Classic
-Black Cat- Claws
-M.O.D.O.K- Spidok :M.O.D.O.A.
-Punisher- Noir
-Lash- Modern
 
* New uniforms will be on sale for a limited time.
* You may check the new uniforms in uniform tab!
 
▣ New Missions for Halloween

  With Halloween on the horizon, we have introduced a new Halloween stage!
 
  When running the Halloween event, you can receive Halloween Tokens. These tokens can then be traded for the 3 new characters Biometrics.
 
  * Number of Biometrics will be given randomly
  * In the Halloween Box, you will get a chance to get any of the new characters Biometrics randomly. 
 
▣ Inventory Improvement
 
 1. Select and Sell
For your convenience, we added the feature that you can sell many items at once.
Now you can clear your inventory faster than ever!

We may not help to restore the items you already sell!
 
 2. Cover Pieces
   - When you are looking in your inventory, you can now access your cover collection easily. This will allow you to fuse your pieces much easier than before.

 
▣ Mission Auto Repeat
 
 You can now use your clear tickets (and energy) to automatically run through missions on repeat! This feature is for Daily Missions, Special Missions, Story Missions and Dimension Rifts!
 
 
※ Auto Repeat is only available for cleared Missions with 3 Stars.
※ You will earn experience points for Alliance, S.H.I.E.L.D. and Characters.
※ You can freely tap the team members and/or Skills during Auto Repeat
※ Auto Repeat can be stopped for following reasons
-Dimension rifts opening in Story Mode
-Special Stage reaching 100%
-All Biometrics collected (3/3) 
 
 
▣ New 6★ Skills
 


New 6★ Skills added for Thor, Black Bolt, and Punisher!
 1. Thor : Thundering Maelstrom
 2. Black Bolt : Quasi-Sonic Scream
   - "Sonic Scream" changed to 6★ skill
   - Due to skill set changes, Black Bolt got new 5★ Skill "Brutal Whisper"
 3. Punisher : Incendiary Rocket
 
▣ Character Balancing for Thor & Black Bolt
 
Character Balancing for Thor and Black Bolt to dominate enemies more effectively.
 
 1. Thor
  - With his normal attack Thor throws his Mjolnir to attack enemies at distance.
- Skill motion and range has been improved for "Hammer Throw" and "Battle Rage"
 
 2. Black Bolt
  - Range for normal attack has been increased
  - Now he dashes faster with new motion!
  - "Quasi-Sonic Scream" Changed to 6★ Skill
  - New 5★ Skill "Brutal Whisper" added
  - "Anti-Gravitational Dash" Skill range has been widened.
  - "Power Word" skill range has been widened and now it can attack stacked enemies.
 
▣ Auto Change features and improvement in using of ISO-8 Set
 
  For your convenience, you can use Auto Set Change function to change ISO-8 sets easily and conveniently.
 
 1. If you tap Auto Set Change you will see the choices below. It will roll 20 times automatically, and stops if it meets the requirements you choose.
※ Every roll costs 10,000 Gold for ISO-8 set change


-If certain set you chose appeared before reroll, Auto Set Change stops.

 2. If you unfortunately failed to get the ideal set, you may try again if you have enough amount of Gold.
 
▣ Other Improvements
 1. Some Skills in Team Attacks has been modified
   - [S.H.I.E.L.D. Divas] : Black Widow's Skill has been changed to Coup de Grâce
   - [Enemy or Ally?] : Black Cat's skill has been changed to Cat Scratch
 2. Hero sorting feature has been added to the Warp Device
 3. Now you can skip the mission clear effect in the Warp Device results window
 4. You can now check the quantity of items in your inventory by long pressing items on mission loot tables.
 5. Added elemental effects on some villains in missions
  - Iron Mutated Inhuman - Fire
  - Fire Wielder - Fire
  - Poison Mutated Inhuman - Poison
  - Ice Wielder - Cold
 6. Fixed an issue with Cooldown Timer reset of Spider Man's Webslinger skill
 7. Fixed an issue with Illusions not doing correct damage in Multi-Play
  - Skills : Sister Grimm(Now you see me…), Loki(Mind Games), Kingpin(Criminal Mastermind)
 8. Fixed an issue with Thor's Unifrom not shooting Lightning sometimes
9. Hero Chests have been added
  -You can get ★1~★6 Heroes from New Hero Chest
  -New Hero Chests: ★1~★4 Hero Chest, ★3~★6 Hero Chest
  ※ If you get a hero you already have, that is a higher rank than your hero, it will automatically rank up.
(i.e I have Iron Man at 2★, the chest gives me a 5★ Iron Man, Iron Man will now be rank 5.
  ※ If the hero you get is of the same or lower rank than your Hero, you will be give a Biometrics Selector (type) with a number of biometrics depending on the rank of your Hero. The selector will be sent to your inbox.
(i.e I have a 4 ★ Vision, and the chest gives me a 2 ★ Vision, I will be given a Biometrics Selector (Blast).
10. Gold change




EDIT:

11. There are new Alliance Battle stages in Alliance Battle
12. Alliance Battle will now reset entries at Fridays at 01:00 (UTC+0)
